Of the (PSM, protein) pairs affected: 4623 named a protein that does not contain the stored peptide -- typically a PSM ambiguous between peptide sequences (level 4 or 5), where this protein carries a different candidate than the first, which is the one stored. Sites on the other proteins of the same PSMs are written. Counts are in bundle.json under protein_databases.

2 modification(s) could not be mapped to a UNIMOD accession or a mass, and are carried in ProForma as [Info:...] tags: Common Biological:Hydroxybutyrylation on K, Trypsin Digested:GG (Ubiquitination Site) on K. Their ptm_sites rows exist and carry modification_name, with modification null, so a query by name finds them and a query by UNIMOD accession will not.

The producer wrote some rows more than once, identical in every column, and the copies were dropped so each identifier appears once. Nothing was lost: the kept row is byte-for-byte what the duplicates said. Rows that share an identifier and disagree anywhere are still refused rather than collapsed. protein_groups: 1 identifier(s), 1 row(s) dropped, e.g. PXD067622:A6NCW0;A8MUK1;C9J2P7;C9JJH3;C9JLJ4;C9JPN9;C9JVI0;D6R901;D6R9N7;D6RA61;D6RBQ6;D6RCP7;D6RJB6;Q0WX57;Q7RTZ2 written 2 times; quant_values: 3 identifier(s), 3 row(s) dropped, e.g. PXD067622:20240830_HF_LC3_MAA_RK_12032_CA_DMSO4:label_free:protein_group:PXD067622:A6NCW0;A8MUK1;C9J2P7;C9JJH3;C9JLJ4;C9JPN9;C9JVI0;D6R901;D6R9N7;D6RA61;D6RBQ6;D6RCP7;D6RJB6;Q0WX57;Q7RTZ2:PROVISIONAL:PROTEIN-SPECTRAL-COUNT written 2 times. The full list is in bundle.json under collapsed_duplicates.
The search did not write an SDRF back out, so sample metadata comes from the deposited SDRF only. Producer's note: no reanalysis SDRF written (WriteSdrf is MetaMorpheus #2816, unreleased)

datasets.summary: PXD067622 is a DDA label-free dataset (Homo sapiens) with 24 runs, 24 samples and enrichment: proximity_labelling. It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.11. At 1% FDR the search reports 620,539 PSMs, 44,352 peptidoforms and 4,147 protein groups, and the repository holds 20,596 PTM sites for it. 5 open warnings about it are recorded.
